results.title: SK hynix Developing New NAND Products for KV Cache ...
results.content:
KV cache is temporary data required for graphics processing units (GPUs) to handle AI computations. As AI data surges, the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity for storing KV cache is reaching its limits. In response, SK hynix plans to develop new products that mount high-capacity NAND products near the GPU, allowing them to serve as an additional KV cache repository. [...] SK hynix (000660.KS) said on the 29th during its second-quarter earnings conference call that it is developing new NAND product families such as "near-GPU storage" driven by key-value (KV) cache offloading. "We are proceeding with NAND development in a direction that most efficiently delivers the performance customers require," the company said. results.title: Decoding the Jargon and Impact on Samsung, SK Hynix
results.content: The problem emerged as AI began processing data equivalent to dozens of books at once. The notepad (KV cache) fills up almost instantly, creating a bottleneck. Previously, the only option was to spend enormous sums simply adding more memory chips. [...] To understand what TurboQuant is and what impact it may have, one must first decode the alien terminology. AI reads human language by breaking it into units called tokens — fragments of words. As a conversation grows longer, the AI temporarily writes down earlier tokens' context in memory such as HBM so it does not lose track. It is like sticking Post-it notes beside a thick book to remember the content. This temporary AI notepad is called the KV cache (Key-Value Cache).
